name: Question 4
problem:
For the universal set $U,$ given by

$$
U={5,10,15,20,25,30,35},
$$

find the truth set of $P(x)⇔Q(x)$ for the following predicates: 

- $P(x):$ $x$ is odd.

- $Q(x):$ $\sqrt{x}$ is integer.
worked_solution:
Since we have that

$$
P(x)⇔Q(x)≡(P(x)∧Q(x))∨(¬P(x)∧¬Q(x)),
$$

the corresponding truth set can be found as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{P⇔Q}=({T}_{P}\cap {T}_{Q})\cup ({\overset{―}{T}}_{P}\cap {\overset{―}{T}}_{Q})\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that:

- The truth set of $P(x)$ is 

$$
{T}_{P}={5,15,25,35}
$$

and its complement is

$$
{\overset{―}{T}}_{P}={10,20,30}.
$$

- The truth set of $Q(x)$ is 

$$
{T}_{Q}={25}
$$

 
and its complement is

$$
{\overset{―}{T}}_{Q}={5,10,15,20,30,35}.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{T}_{P}\cap {T}_{Q} & ={5,15,25,35}\cap {25} \\  & ={25} \\ {\overset{―}{T}}_{P}\cap {\overset{―}{T}}_{Q} & ={10,20,30}\cap {5,10,15,20,30,35} \\  & ={10,20,30} \\ {T}_{P⇔Q} & =({T}_{P}\cap {T}_{Q})\cup ({\overset{―}{T}}_{P}\cap {\overset{―}{T}}_{Q}) \\  & ={25}\cup {10,20,30} \\  & ={10,20,25,30}.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 4
?

For the universal set U, given by

U={5,10,15,20,25,30,35},

find the truth set of P(x)⇔Q(x) for the following predicates:

  • P(x): x is odd.

  • Q(x): x is integer.

a
{5,10,15,30,35}
b
∅
c
{25}
d
{10,20,30}
e
{10,20,25,30}
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Since we have that

P(x)⇔Q(x)≡(P(x)∧Q(x))∨(¬P(x)∧¬Q(x)), the corresponding truth set can be found as follows:

TP⇔Q=(TP∩TQ)∪(T―P∩T―Q)

Notice that:

  • The truth set of P(x) is TP={5,15,25,35} and its complement is T―P={10,20,30}.

  • The truth set of Q(x) is TQ={25} and its complement is T―Q={5,10,15,20,30,35}.

Therefore, we have

TP∩TQ={5,15,25,35}∩{25}={25}T―P∩T―Q={10,20,30}∩{5,10,15,20,30,35}={10,20,30}TP⇔Q=(TP∩TQ)∪(T―P∩T―Q)={25}∪{10,20,30}={10,20,25,30}.
